summary: When you sign in to GitHub Desktop 3.6.10 or later, eligible accounts can now use short-lived, automatically refreshing authentication tokens. Short-lived access tokens reduce how long a leaked token can be used.
takeaways: Desktop automatically refreshes them for GitHub API requests and Git operations, keeping token renewal out of your everyday workflow.
